title: Defy Gravity
description: Learn how quantum levitation works in under a minute.

scenes.narration: Imagine objects floating in mid-air with no visible support.
This is quantum levitation, made possible by magnetic fields.
Superconductors are the key to creating this effect.
When cooled, they can expel magnetic fields, allowing objects to float.
The results are mind-bending, defying our understanding of gravity.
And the future of transportation and engineering hangs in the balance.
